fight_technique_name: False Base Station Or Access Point
actions: Deploy NAS sequence number validation with a rolling window of 3.
Enforce NAS-EMM EEA4 integrity checks against known vendor baselines.
Implement RRC-level IMSI filtering for gsm_a_common_elem_id=11.
Set NAS-EPS sequence number threshold alerts at 20 deviations.
Enable 5G core NAS trace logging for gsm_a_common_elem_id=11.
Configure RAN to drop NAS messages with nas-eps_seq_no_value > 100.
Deploy NAS anomaly detection with a 5-minute counter reset.
Update core network to reject NAS-EMM EEA4 with value=106.
Enforce NAS trace rate limiting at 1000 messages/minute per UE.

mapped_mitigations.fgm_name: Discard RAN Signaling Received Without Integrity Protection
